title: Default spherical Geometry and Feature operations through pinned local S2
priority: Official GEE syntax, argument names and defaults first; original broader goal remains active.

entry_inventory.interpretation: Name count only, not complete signatures, numerical semantics, all default consumers, migration success or Google equivalence.

implementation.contract: Geometry and finite inline Feature contains/containedIn/intersects/disjoint/intersection/union/difference/symmetricDifference accept omitted/null proj and maxError with supported spherical inputs. Explicit planar EPSG:4326 remains a separate GEOS branch.
implementation.defaults: Numeric EE geometries retain effective EPSG:4326, geodesic=true and evenOdd=true. Public omission is preserved; explicit child flags override inherited flags. Points/empty children do not invent mixed edge models.
implementation.native: Actual pinned S2 C ABI; no runtime fetch. Source/artifact/platform/ABI/license attestation, source-set and physical ancestor checks on initial and cached loads. Closed finite numeric wire, independent native bounds and tracked memory.
implementation.values: Actual dimensions, empties, holes, dateline/polar and left-inside cases. Full sphere has a distinct internal value and rejects public JSON/CSV. Exact source-vector reuse preserves unchanged input coordinates without epsilon equality.
implementation.public_flags: Point/MultiPoint omit unsupported edge/interior flags; lines publish edge model; polygons publish edge/interior model; collection context preserved. Explicit planar results expose false geodesic flags instead of silently changing on SDK roundtrip.
implementation.features: Overlays own left properties and actual existing left ID only. Geometry getters revalidate mutable values and detach coordinates, retaining inferred metadata.
implementation.CSV: All rows and siblings validate and precharge aggregate native work before any native call. Actual spherical outputs pass CSV-to-official-SDK roundtrip. Curved table bounds use a conservative world envelope, not a fabricated tight bbox.
implementation.consumers: Explicit spherical edges reject before legacy planar clip/reduceRegion/spatial-filter/footprint-union consumers. Legacy unflagged raster input remains planar and is not default GEE geodesic compatibility.
implementation.unchanged_limits: Compiler50000work, graph500/1MB, geometry10000positions/1000children/16depth, CSV1000rows/256columns/50000cells/1MB. C ABI65536double wire; S2 tracker64MiB is tracked work memory, not total process RSS.
